name: When is it time to replace my shingle roof?

mainEntity.name: When is it time to replace my shingle roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your shingle roof may need replacement. Look for shingles that are curling, buckling, or missing, especially after a storm. Granule loss, visible in gutters or on the ground, is another common indicator that shingles are aging and losing their protective qualities. If your roof is over 20-25 years old, even without obvious damage, it's wise to have a professional inspection. Water leaks inside your home, dark spots on ceilings, or a sagging roof deck are urgent signs requiring immediate attention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key signs for shingle roof replacement include curling or missing shingles, granule loss, roof age (over 20-25 years), or visible leaks and sagging.
